name: Pond
description: Durable, lossless recall over past agent sessions. Read-only pond_search / pond_get_session / pond_get_message / pond_sql tools backed by a local pond store.

pond.mode.label: Pond Mode
pond.mode.help: managed: the plugin spawns and supervises a local pond process (default). url: attach to an external pond serve endpoint.

pond.syncIntervalMinutes.label: Sync Interval (minutes)
pond.syncIntervalMinutes.help: How often the managed pond process ingests new OpenClaw sessions.

pond.binaryPath.label: Pond Binary Path
pond.binaryPath.help: Explicit path to the pond binary; defaults to searching PATH.

pond.url.label: Pond URL
pond.url.help: External pond serve endpoint for url mode.

pond.headers.label: Pond HTTP Headers
pond.headers.help: Headers sent to the url-mode endpoint (e.g. Authorization for an auth shim).

sources.label: Corpus Sources
sources.help: pond source_agent filter. ["openclaw"] recalls OpenClaw sessions only; ["*"] opts into the whole cross-harness corpus.

groupSessions.label: Group Session Scope
groupSessions.help: clamp: group/channel callers are narrowed to their own session tree (default). inherit: groups use the operator-configured visibility.
